where: The Undertide, the sea-caves under the Farlamp Isles: dark tidal channels, dripping water, tide-bells ringing far away
mood: A sea-cave in the deep: drips, distant bells, the isles' hymn broken into low fragments.
_motif_note: Medium on motif-farlamp.json: the cave rung keeps only fragments of the hymn, low.
_stall_note: deliberately sparse cave cue: drips in a held hush are part of it
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
D minor with a dark Phrygian E flat
a low hollow pulse-wave lead playing short broken fragments of a seafaring hymn, long rests between
high plinking water-drip notes with fainter echoes
distant soft tide-bells ringing in the dark
a deep held bass drone like the tide
mysterious, deep, dark and still, a sea-cave under the waves

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a deep bass drone, then a single water drip and its fainter echo}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {low broken fragments of the hymn tune on a hollow pulse-wave lead, three notes then a pause, drips plinking around them, a far tide-bell}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the fragments again, a little longer, tide-bells answering from deeper in the cave, a soft tom far away}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the bass leans to a dark E flat, the drips quicken like a tide-race running, then still}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the broken hymn fragments return low and still; the last bar drips straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
